failureDiagnostics.action: Compare compose/compose.test.generated.yaml services with docs/architecture/composed-service-integration-test-matrix.json serviceIntegrationRows before rerunning proof.
Inspect the generated service profile stanza and the service catalogue test environment policy; do not hand-edit generated Compose.
Run the Compose port validator and reconcile the service catalogue port metadata before regenerating Compose.
Check depends_on conditions and healthcheck-bearing dependencies against the generated test Compose target and service catalogue.
Run the generator in check mode only; do not edit compose/*.generated.yaml by hand.
Add or repair fixture corpus and integration matrix evidence before claiming the service was exercised.
Capture the project name, remaining resource IDs, and failing residue check; rerun teardown before retrying.

enterpriseEvidenceModelRowsDeferredByCoo.description: Bounded evidence row for compose-profile orchestration commands, every generated test Compose service exercise coverage, profile omission/default-promotion guardrails, and residue diagnostics.
Maps USF-251 local test orchestration evidence to service orchestration and environment control support without claiming certification or production readiness.
Records reset, cleanup, teardown, and post-run residue checks as local test resilience evidence only.
